set(SDL_TESTS OFF CACHE BOOL "" FORCE)
set(SDL_EXAMPLES OFF CACHE BOOL "" FORCE)

add_subdirectory(
    ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/SDL3
    ${CMAKE_BINARY_DIR}/ThirdParty/SDL3
    EXCLUDE_FROM_ALL
)

set(SPDLOG_BUILD_TESTS OFF CACHE BOOL "" FORCE)
set(SPDLOG_BUILD_EXAMPLE OFF CACHE BOOL "" FORCE)
set(SPDLOG_BUILD_BENCH OFF CACHE BOOL "" FORCE)
set(SPDLOG_BUILD_SHARED OFF CACHE BOOL "" FORCE)

add_subdirectory(
    ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/spdlog
    ${CMAKE_BINARY_DIR}/ThirdParty/spdlog
    EXCLUDE_FROM_ALL
)

# VOLK
add_library(volk STATIC
    volk/volk.c
)

target_include_directories(volk PUBLIC
    ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/volk
    ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/Vulkan/include
)


# target_compile_definitions(volk PUBLIC
#     VK_NO_PROTOTYPES
# )

set(CPPTRACE_BUILD_TESTING OFF CACHE BOOL "" FORCE)
set(CPPTRACE_BUILD_BENCHMARKING OFF CACHE BOOL "" FORCE)
set(CPPTRACE_BUILD_TOOLS OFF CACHE BOOL "" FORCE)

add_subdirectory(
    ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/cpptrace
    ${CMAKE_BINARY_DIR}/ThirdParty/cpptrace
    EXCLUDE_FROM_ALL
)

set(GLM_BUILD_TESTS OFF CACHE BOOL "" FORCE)
set(GLM_BUILD_INSTALL OFF CACHE BOOL "" FORCE)

add_subdirectory(
    ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/glm
    ${CMAKE_BINARY_DIR}/ThirdParty/glm
    EXCLUDE_FROM_ALL
)


set(VULKAN_HEADERS_ENABLE_TESTS OFF CACHE BOOL "" FORCE)
set(VULKAN_HEADERS_ENABLE_INSTALL OFF CACHE BOOL "" FORCE)

add_subdirectory(
    ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/Vulkan
    ${CMAKE_BINARY_DIR}/ThirdParty/Vulkan
    EXCLUDE_FROM_ALL
)

set(VMA_BUILD_SAMPLES OFF CACHE BOOL "" FORCE)

add_subdirectory(
    ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/VMA
    ${CMAKE_BINARY_DIR}/ThirdParty/VMA
    EXCLUDE_FROM_ALL
)
